Program.Text053:
XFEEliteDangerous local tool
status [--data directory]
create-account --email email --name name --password-stdin
inventory --email email --password-stdin [--account ID]
credits --delta amount --version version --email email --password-stdin
set-quantity --category cargo|materials --item ID --item-category category --quantity amount --version version --email email --password-stdin
import-journal --journal directory --version version --email email --password-stdin
export --output new-file --email email --password-stdin
inspect --game game-directory
All account commands accept --data; add --account to manage another account. The first registered account is the local administrator.
Use --language en-US|zh-CN|system to select the display language.
